receiptType: FROM STORE: Use 'FiscalInvoice' for normal store invoice (fixed; no type picker in store flow)
receiptCurrency: FROM STORE: controller.selectedCurrency (e.g. USD from Currency dropdown)
receiptGlobalNo: WE DON'T HAVE: Not from Store UI – use from device/fiscal day (e.g. 1 or AppConstant)
invoiceNo: WE DON'T HAVE: Store flow does not collect invoice number – must generate (e.g. same sequence as add-invoice) or let backend assign

buyerData.buyerRegisterName: WE DON'T HAVE: No customer in store flow – use placeholder e.g. 'Walk-in Customer' or 'Cash Sale'
buyerData.buyerTIN: WE DON'T HAVE: No customer TIN – use placeholder e.g. '0000000000'
buyerData.buyerVAT: WE DON'T HAVE: No customer VAT – use empty string ''

buyerAddress.houseNumber: WE DON'T HAVE: No customer address – use '' or minimal placeholder
buyerAddress.street: WE DON'T HAVE: No customer address – use '' or minimal placeholder
buyerAddress.city: WE DON'T HAVE: No customer address – use '' or minimal placeholder
buyerAddress.province: WE DON'T HAVE: No customer address – use '' or minimal placeholder

receiptLinesTaxInclusive: FROM STORE: true (store uses tax-inclusive pricing; controller calculates tax from taxGroup)

receiptLines.receiptLineHSCode: WE DON'T HAVE: InventoryItem has no hsCode – use default '99001000'
receiptLines.receiptLineType: FROM STORE: Fixed 'Sale' for each line
receiptLines.receiptLineNo: FROM STORE: Line index 1, 2, 3... from selectedQuantities order
receiptLines.receiptLineName: FROM STORE: InventoryItem.itemName (e.g. 'C001 - Broiler Pre-Starter Crumbs 10kg')
receiptLines.receiptLineQuantity: FROM STORE: selectedQuantities[item.id] for this item
receiptLines.receiptLineTotal: FROM STORE: item.price * quantity (tax-inclusive), format to 2 decimals
receiptLines.taxID: WE DON'T HAVE: InventoryItem has no taxID – use default 2

receiptPayments.moneyTypeCode: FROM STORE: Use 'CASH' (or add payment type from Tender if needed later)
receiptPayments.paymentAmount: FROM STORE: Same as receiptTotal – controller.calculateGrandTotal() to 2 decimals

receiptTotal: FROM STORE: controller.calculateGrandTotal() formatted to 2 decimals
receiptTaxAmount: FROM STORE: controller.calculateTotalTax() formatted to 2 decimals
receiptNotes: ONLY FOR CREDIT/DEBIT: Store normal invoice does not use this; for CreditNote/DebitNote use notes text
creditDebitNote: ONLY FOR CREDIT/DEBIT: Store flow is normal invoice only – no creditDebitNote block; for Credit/Debit note would need: deviceID, receiptGlobalNo, fiscalDayNo, and originalInvoice (we don't have original invoice number in store flow)
